from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg}
    comps=[]; unseen=set(cells)
    while unseen:
        s=unseen.pop(); comp={s}; q=[s]
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen: unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        comps.append(comp)
    template=max(comps,key=len)
    # Distinctive anchor: the 8 in the source pattern.
    anchors=[p for p in template if g[p[0]][p[1]]==8]
    ar,ac=anchors[0] if anchors else (min(r for r,c in template),min(c for r,c in template))
    stamp=[(r-ar,c-ac,g[r][c]) for r,c in template]
    markers=[p for comp in comps if comp is not template for p in comp]
    for r,c in markers: g[r][c]=bg
    for r,c in markers:
        for dr,dc,color in stamp:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: g[rr][cc]=color
    return g
PY
